description: Receive what the designer sent from a motion playground opened with open_motion_playground. Each send carries the designer's note (instruction), what they were looking at (context), and the motion as tuned (packet), along with the playground's url and html_path. Act on the note using the packet; when the note is empty, the packet itself is what they want. Returns at once with anything already sent, and each send is returned only once. When you expect a send, pass timeout_ms, up to 240000, to wait for it.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the first send when none has arrived yet, in milliseconds, up to 240000; larger values wait 240000. 0 or omitted returns at once.

name: get_motion_sends
